views.purpose: To understand the allowed-to-use relations and package boundary crossings between the presentation, application, domain, and data persistence layers.
To identify core runtime components, connectors, and communication mechanisms used to collaborate for main system functionalities.
To document the architectural decision records (ADRs) that define the current decomposition of layers, subsystems, and their dependencies.
To define the system boundary and identify external actors and systems that interface directly with the main architectural components.
To review the overall organization of the system into layers and subsystems, illustrating the separation of user-facing functionality, application logic, domain entities, and data persistence.

notes: Selected viewpoints align with the current-and-future-architect profile and cover all architectural questions (AQ1-AQ5) regarding system decomposition, runtime collaboration, layering, boundaries, and decision rationale.
